# Mind of Matt

> > Personal technical blog covering Linux audio conversion, FTP clients, software recommendations, and hardware solutions.

Mind of Matt (ma.juii.net) is a technical blog by Matt featuring practical guides and software recommendations primarily focused on Linux systems, audio file conversion (WAV, AMR), and developer tools. The site provides hands-on solutions for command-line tools, GUI applications, and hardware configurations.

## Key Topics

- Linux
- audio-conversion
- WAV
- AMR
- amrconvert
- Perl
- 3GPP TS 26.104
- sox
- FTP clients
- konqueror
- gftp
- command-line-tools
- software-comparison
- HTML editors
- IBM ThinkPad T23

## Linux Audio & Media Tools

- [Wie kann ich unter Linux WAV-Dateien in AMR-Dateien konvertieren und andersherum?](https://ma.juii.net/blog/wie-kann-ich-unter-linux-wav-dateien-in-amr-dateien-konvertieren-und-andersherum): Linux audio conversion guide: WAV to AMR using Perl amrconvert tool

## Linux Software Recommendations

- [Welcher grafische FTP-Client ist unter Linux zu empfehlen?](https://ma.juii.net/blog/welcher-grafische-ftp-client-ist-unter-linux-zu-empfehlen): Linux FTP client comparison: konqueror, gftp, kasablanca, kftpgrabber

## Windows Development Tools

- [Zu empfehlender Freeware-HTML-Editor für Windows?](https://ma.juii.net/blog/zu-empfehlender-freeware-html-editor-fur-windows): Freeware HTML editor recommendation: 1st Page 2000 for Windows

## Hardware & Backup Solutions

- [Idee für Datensicherung mit einem IBM Thinkpad T23?](https://ma.juii.net/blog/idee-fur-datensicherung-mit-einem-ibm-thinkpad-t23): Backup solution for IBM ThinkPad T23 using Ultrabay 2000 adapter
